Most warehouse jobs are about keeping things running. This one is about keeping things running while you rebuild them.
 

My client, an international manufacturer, wants a Warehouse Manager who can run a large operation and has the appetite to change how it works. You get the mandate to shape the team, redesign the flows and bring LEAN into daily practice. You lead through your Team Leaders and sit on the operations management team.
 

What you are responsible forThe warehouse has two customers. One is the production floor, which needs materials on time and in full to keep the lines going. The other is the end customer, who expects a complete and correct delivery. You own both flows, from the moment goods arrive at the dock until they leave the site.
 

Running the operation
 
 

• You plan and steer receiving, storage, picking, packing and shipping. 

• When volumes peak or dip, you move people and capacity to where they are needed. 

• Every goods movement has to be in the ERP system correctly and on time. You make sure it is. 

• You decide how the space is used and change the layout when the flows change. 

• Forklifts, scanners and other equipment stay in good shape under your watch.  

Getting stock rightProduction and shipping only work when the numbers in the system match what is on the shelf. You take ownership of that. You set up structured cycle counts and follow up on every deviation. When something is off, you look for the cause in the process and fix it there. You keep master data, locations and labelling up to date, and you make sure every item can be traced.
 

Improving how the warehouse worksThis is where you leave your mark. You define the vision and standards for the warehouse and you apply LEAN tools such as 5S, kanban and just-in-time replenishment. You look at every flow with a critical eye and take out what adds no value, like waiting time, double handling and buffers nobody needs. Lead times from receipt to storage and from order to shipment go down. You anchor the improvements with standard work, visual management and clear procedures, and you keep the documentation and training material current.
 

Leading the team
 
 

• You lead, coach and develop your Team Leaders and, through them, the whole warehouse team. 

• You put people in the roles where they perform best and recruit when the team needs it. 

• You invest in training and cross-training, so the team can handle change. 

• You set clear targets and follow them up in a way people understand. 

• You hold performance and development conversations with your direct reports.  

SafetySafety comes first in your warehouse, for everyone. You make sure hazardous goods are stored correctly, loads are handled safely and the workplace stays clean and organized.
 

Budget and reportingYou report on the warehouse KPIs: accuracy, productivity, on-time delivery and safety. You prepare and manage the budget. When the warehouse needs new equipment, automation or a new layout, you build the business case.
 

Who you work withYou work closely with production, planning, quality, finance and IT. Externally you are the contact for carriers, suppliers and staffing agencies.

Background
 
 

• Bachelor’s degree in logistics, supply chain or industrial engineering, or equivalent experience. 

• At least 5 years, preferably more, as a warehouse or logistics manager in a production environment. 

• Experience leading a large team, preferably through team leaders. 

• You have improved inventory accuracy before and can show the results. 

• You have led LEAN or change projects on the floor.  

Knowledge
 
 

• You know warehouse processes inside out, from receipt to shipment. 

• You can design and improve material flows and layouts. 

• You use LEAN tools in practice. 

• Strong hands-on SAP experience (MM, WM or EWM). This is a must. 

• You are at ease with Excel and MS Office.  

Languages
 
 

• Fluent in Dutch, French and English.  

Who you areYou are on the floor as much as behind your desk. You analyze before you act, and once you decide, you follow through. Details matter to you because you know what a wrong count costs further down the line. You can explain why a change is needed and get your team behind it.

Sentea is growing, and we are looking for a 
Senior Embedded Software Engineer  to strengthen our team.
 

As a Senior Embedded Software Engineer, you will shape the software behind our silicon photonics-based fiber sensor read-out systems. You will work across the complete software stack: from defining the overall architecture to embedded C/C++ on Linux and FPGA firmware, through to network interfaces and Python APIs, and the implementation and validation of our signal processing algorithms.
 

This is a hands-on role for an experienced engineer who enjoys owning a system end to end, works closely with the hardware team, and takes pride in building robust, well-tested software that runs reliably in the field.
 

What will you do?
 

Your role:
 
 

• Define the software architecture of our fiber sensor read-out systems 

• Implement and validate the embedded software and signal-processing algorithms 

• Work closely with the hardware and photonics teams  

Who are we looking for?
 

Ideally, you have:
 
 

• At least 5 years of experience in software development. 

• Strong software engineering practices (version control systems, CI/CD, TDD) 

• Experience programming embedded systems in C/C++ 

• Experience with FPGA design (Verilog, VHDL, HLS, Vivado) 

• Experience with embedded Linux 

• Knowledge of network protocols (TCP/IP) and web protocols 

• Knowledge of industrial communication protocols (e.g. Modbus, PROFINET, MQTT, …) is a plus 

• Experience developing APIs in Python 

• Affinity with hardware: you understand electronic circuits and enjoy working with the hardware team 

• Able to work independently 

• Experience with Agile development and project management is a plus 

• Languages: English, Dutch is a plus 

• Willing to work from our office in Zwijnaarde  

What we offer
 

At Sentea, you will work in a growing deep-tech company developing advanced fiber-optic sensing technology based on silicon photonics.
 

You will have the opportunity to shape the software of cutting-edge photonic read-out systems and help turn advanced technology into reliable products. As part of a small, multidisciplinary team, you will have a varied role covering software architecture, embedded development, algorithms and validation, working closely with photonics and hardware engineers from concept to field deployment.
